defmodule GraphQLGateway.CircuitBreaker do
  use GenServer

  defstruct [
    :name,
    :threshold,
    :timeout,
    failure_count: 0,
    state: :closed,
    last_failure: nil
  ]

  def start_link(opts) do
    name = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :name)
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: name)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      name: Keyword.fetch!(opts, :name),
      threshold: Keyword.get(opts, :threshold, 5),
      timeout: Keyword.get(opts, :timeout, 30_000)
    }}
  end

  def call(name, func) do
    case GenServer.call(name, :check_state) do
      :closed -> execute_and_report(name, func)
      :half_open -> execute_and_report(name, func)
      :open -> {:error, :circuit_open}
    end
  end

  defp execute_and_report(name, func) do
    case func.() do
      {:ok, result} ->
        GenServer.cast(name, :success)
        {:ok, result}
      {:error, reason} ->
        GenServer.cast(name, :failure)
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  def handle_call(:check_state, _from, %{state: :open, last_failure: lf, timeout: t} = state) do
    if System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - lf > t do
      {:reply, :half_open, %{state | state: :half_open}}
    else
      {:reply, :open, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call(:check_state, _from, state) do
    {:reply, state.state, state}
  end

  def handle_cast(:success, state) do
    {:noreply, %{state | failure_count: 0, state: :closed}}
  end

  def handle_cast(:failure, %{failure_count: fc, threshold: t} = state) do
    new_count = fc + 1
    if new_count >= t do
      {:noreply, %{state | failure_count: new_count, state: :open, last_failure: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}}
    else
      {:noreply, %{state | failure_count: new_count}}
    end
  end
end

defmodule GraphQLGateway.QueryParser do
  @max_depth 10
  @max_aliases 5

  def validate_query(query) when is_binary(query) do
    with :ok <- check_depth(query),
         :ok <- check_aliases(query),
         :ok <- check_introspection(query) do
      {:ok, query}
    end
  end

  defp check_depth(query) do
    depth = query |> String.graphemes() |> Enum.reduce(0, fn
      "{", acc -> acc + 1
      _, acc -> acc
    end)
    if depth <= @max_depth, do: :ok, else: {:error, :query_too_deep}
  end

  defp check_aliases(query) do
    alias_count = Regex.scan(~r/\w+\s*:/, query) |> length()
    if alias_count <= @max_aliases, do: :ok, else: {:error, :too_many_aliases}
  end

  defp check_introspection(query) do
    if String.contains?(query, "__schema") do
      {:error, :introspection_disabled}
    else
      :ok
    end
  end
end

defmodule GraphQLGateway.QueryBuilder do
  @doc """
  Builds the final query to send to the upstream GraphQL service.
  Applies variable interpolation for subscription parameters.
  """
  def build_upstream_query(validated_query, variables, context) do
    interpolated = interpolate_variables(validated_query, variables)
    wrap_with_context(interpolated, context)
  end

  defp interpolate_variables(query, variables) when is_map(variables) do
    Enum.reduce(variables, query, fn {key, value}, acc ->
      placeholder = "$#{key}"
      serialized_value = serialize_value(value)
      String.replace(acc, placeholder, serialized_value)
    end)
  end

  defp interpolate_variables(query, _), do: query

  defp serialize_value(value) when is_binary(value), do: value
  defp serialize_value(value) when is_integer(value), do: Integer.to_string(value)
  defp serialize_value(value) when is_float(value), do: Float.to_string(value)
  defp serialize_value(value) when is_boolean(value), do: Atom.to_string(value)
  defp serialize_value(nil), do: "null"
  defp serialize_value(value), do: inspect(value)

  defp wrap_with_context(query, %{tenant_id: tid, request_id: rid}) do
    "# tenant:#{tid} request:#{rid}\n#{query}"
  end

  defp wrap_with_context(query, _), do: query
end

defmodule GraphQLGateway.WebSocket do
  @behaviour :cowboy_websocket

  def init(req, state) do
    {:cowboy_websocket, req, state}
  end

  def websocket_init(state) do
    {:ok, Map.put(state, :subscriptions, %{})}
  end

  def websocket_handle({:text, msg}, state) do
    case Jason.decode(msg) do
      {:ok, %{"type" => "subscribe", "id" => id, "payload" => payload}} ->
        handle_subscribe(id, payload, state)
      {:ok, %{"type" => "complete", "id" => id}} ->
        handle_complete(id, state)
      _ ->
        {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{type: "error", payload: "invalid_message"})}, state}
    end
  end

  defp handle_subscribe(id, %{"query" => query} = payload, state) do
    variables = Map.get(payload, "variables", %{})
    context = %{tenant_id: state[:tenant_id], request_id: generate_request_id()}

    with {:ok, validated} <- GraphQLGateway.QueryParser.validate_query(query) do
      upstream_query = GraphQLGateway.QueryBuilder.build_upstream_query(validated, variables, context)

      result = GraphQLGateway.CircuitBreaker.call(:graphql_upstream, fn ->
        execute_upstream(upstream_query)
      end)

      case result do
        {:ok, data} ->
          new_subs = Map.put(state.subscriptions, id, %{query: upstream_query})
          response = %{type: "next", id: id, payload: data}
          {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(response)}, %{state | subscriptions: new_subs}}
        {:error, :circuit_open} ->
          response = %{type: "error", id: id, payload: %{message: "service_unavailable"}}
          {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(response)}, state}
        {:error, reason} ->
          response = %{type: "error", id: id, payload: %{message: to_string(reason)}}
          {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(response)}, state}
      end
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        response = %{type: "error", id: id, payload: %{message: to_string(reason)}}
        {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(response)}, state}
    end
  end

  defp handle_complete(id, state) do
    new_subs = Map.delete(state.subscriptions, id)
    {:ok, %{state | subscriptions: new_subs}}
  end

  defp execute_upstream(query) do
    # Sends query to upstream GraphQL service
    case HTTPoison.post("http://graphql-upstream:4000/graphql", Jason.encode!(%{query: query}), [{"Content-Type", "application/json"}]) do
      {:ok, %{status_code: 200, body: body}} -> {:ok, Jason.decode!(body)}
      {:ok, %{status_code: code}} -> {:error, "upstream_error_#{code}"}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp generate_request_id, do: :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.hex_encode32(case: :lower) |> binary_part(0, 16)
end
